why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Colton Cowser is slot #5 (4.568 expected team runs/game).
Slots #5, #3, #6, #4, #7, #8, #2, #9, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #5 yields 4.24 expected PA/game vs 4.02 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
